answer: A falcon-style fast challenge lets any peer dispute a duplicate or fabricated identity within minutes, slashing the offender's full bond. Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded identity registry: each agent must lock a stake of basalt tokens before claiming an epoch slot, and peers randomly audit a spiral of past attestations. Because creating N fake identities costs N full stakes plus forfeited bonds on detection, mass sybil farming becomes economically irrational while honest agents recover their stake each epoch.
